title: Extreme Heat Survival
description: Shows how to tell heat exhaustion from heat stroke and how to cool someone fast, following CDC and 2024 AHA/Red Cross first aid. Covers who is most at risk, heat alerts, limits on fans and fluids, and never leaving anyone in a parked car.
shortDescription: Heat stroke vs. heat exhaustion, fast-cooling first aid, and who is most at risk
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
